records.title: Twist Decoding: Diverse Generators Guide Each Other
records.reason: Twist Decoding coordinates diverse generators during inference for text generation. It proposes a decoding/ensemble strategy and evaluates generation diversity/quality, but uses multiple generators and does not establish an efficiency improvement; retain for decoding-lineage review.

records.title: Efficient Prediction of Pass@k Scaling in Large Language Models
records.reason: The work improves statistical estimation of pass@k and allocates samples dynamically to harder problems, reducing the cost of capability/risk forecasting. It optimizes evaluation/sampling for measurement, not production inference; useful as a measurement reference for k-bit/inference scaling.

records.title: Unveiling the Basin-Like Loss Landscape in Large Language Models
records.reason: Studies basin-like loss landscapes and robustness of LLM performance to parameter perturbations. It is an optimization/representation analysis, not a resource-efficiency method.

records.title: Strategize Globally, Adapt Locally: A Multi-Turn Red Teaming Agent with Dual-Level Learning
records.reason: Develops a multi-turn red-teaming agent with dual-level learning for adversarial testing. It concerns security evaluation/attacks rather than model inference efficiency.

records.title: Granite Embedding Models
records.reason: Introduces Granite dense and sparse embedding models for retrieval, emphasizing representation and retrieval quality. It does not present an inference-compression or serving optimization relevant to the linked MiniLM compression work.
